item.content: IT之家 11 月 2 日消息，萨姆 · 奥尔特曼近期关于内存的言论引发越来越多人反对，埃隆 · 马斯克也加入了这场声讨。上周，这位 OpenAI 首席执行官的一番话在全网、尤其是玩家群体中引发强烈不满。他称，人们把内存装在个人电脑里，而不是放在数据中心，是一件“很糟糕”的事。在和博主 Cheeky Pint 的访谈中，奥尔特曼说：“从全球资源分配角度来看，所有人都把全球有限的 DRAM 资源放在自家电脑里，而内存大部分时间利用率只有 5%，这其实非常糟糕。在供给紧张的大环境下，资源放在云端才能实现利用率最大化。可很多人的直觉恰恰相反。”这番言论遭到大量嘲讽。不少人认为，无论他本意如何，听起来像是想剥夺个人对内存的所有权，迫使全社会把资源交给 OpenAI 这类 AI 企业使用。社交媒体上充斥着批评帖、表情包和短视频，大家纷纷表态要守住自己的内存。也有大量玩梗内容，无数表情包、AI 生成视频调侃这位 AI 富豪。说到 AI 富豪，他的行业对手马斯克也发了一张表情包表态，向数千万粉丝亮出自己在内存所有权这件事上的立场。马斯克在自己旗下的 X 平台发文：“民众也理应拥有属于自己的内存！”配图是昆汀 2009 年电影《无耻混蛋》里的汉斯 · 兰达上校。马斯克还在回复网友的评论时，称奥尔特曼是个“智障”。AI 热潮推高了内存需求，内存供给紧张，显卡、游戏主机、电脑配件价格一路暴涨。受这场“内存危机（RAMpocalypse）”影响，索尼、微软、任天堂全都上调了主机售价；RTX 5090 近乎停售几周之后，RTX 5080 也从英伟达商城下架。有消息称微软下一代 Xbox（代号 Project Helix）定价可能高达 1,800 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 11,990 元人民币）。索尼尚未公布新主机，但分析师判断，受成本压力影响，索尼会尽量推迟新机发布。不过奥尔特曼短期内不太可能改变想法。据 CNBC 消息，他正在推进一轮最高 200 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,332.17 亿元人民币）的融资，由阿联酋投资方联合领投，此前目标是约 300 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,998.26 亿元人民币）。马斯克虽然乐于抨击奥尔特曼，但他自己的 AI 业务同样面临难题。此前他发文承认，因为运营成本“难以为继”，Grok Bot 做了限流处理。不少用户反馈额度消耗速度远超预期，马斯克回复称，这款智能体的服务成本“相对于收入而言高到难以持续”。这条消息在社交平台引发热烈讨论，很多人认为这暴露了生成式 AI 商业模式底层的重大难题。Grok Bot 在 8 月开启公测，10 月末付费周活用户接近 80 万。它可以在虚拟计算机上自主执行任务，算力消耗远高于普通对话机器人。重度用户遭遇额度提前耗尽，不少人选择退订。之后有人提问这件事的影响，马斯克回复：“只是理性做法而已。”

item.content: On Nov. 2, 2000, the International Space Station welcomed its first long-term residents: NASA astronaut Bill Shepherd and two Russian cosmonauts, Yuri Gidzenko and Sergei Krikalev. The mission was called Expedition 1.Before this expedition, NASA had launched five, one-week-long Space Shuttle missions to help build the space station and bring up supplies. But this time, the crew would be staying for four and a half months, and they weren't taking the shuttle. Instead, they took a Russian Soyuz spacecraft, and this was the first Soyuz to ever dock at the space station. During their stay at the space station, they unpacked supplies and installed new equipment, including the first solar arrays. They left on the space shuttle Discovery, which brought up the Expedition 2 crew that would take their place.Expedition 1 crewmates Bill Shepherd, Yuri Gidzenko and Sergei Krikalev pose with a model of the space station as it appeared in 2000. item.title: A rainbow of ancient rocks on Mars | Space photo of the day for Nov. 2, 2026
item.content: In this image, we can see a colorful view of an ancient, rocky Martian hill. (Image credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/UArizona)This rainbow-hued rocky plain looks like the landscape of an alien world. And, it turns out, it is. What is it?In this image, we can see an ancient, rocky hill on Mars. In the Red Planet's Southern Highlands, this alien terrain is chock-full of minerals, which we can see clearly defined in this color-enhanced view of the region.This image was snapped by the HiRISE camera aboard NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), which has been studying the planet's surface, atmosphere and climate since arriving in Martian orbit in March 2006. But this isn't exactly what the surface of the planet would look like through our eyes; the image is color-enhanced. Why would scientists take a natural-color image and turn it rainbow? Doing so enhances the slight color differences in these rocks, allowing researchers to pick out the different minerals. Why is it incredible? As pointed to above, enhancing colors in scientific images can be an incredibly useful tool for exploration. For instance, in this image, the blue- and green-toned rocks could be full of minerals like pyroxenes and olivine, according to scientists analyzing the image. item.content: IT之家 11 月 2 日消息，Anthropic PBC 披露，截至 9 月 30 日的第三季度营收接近 170 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,132.35 亿元人民币），同比暴涨 11 倍，市场对这家 AI 实验室有望创下纪录的 IPO 预期进一步升温。这家 Claude 大模型背后的公司当地时间周一向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交文件显示：截至 9 月末的三个月，净亏损 233 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,551.98 亿元人民币）；去年同期净亏损为 121 亿美元（现汇率约合 805.96 亿元人民币）。本季度运营费用飙升至 175 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,165.65 亿元人民币），同比增幅 292%。文件显示，公司已敲定总额 8,950 亿美元（现汇率约合 5.96 万亿元人民币）的承诺支出，绝大部分用于算力与基础设施建设。其中约 4,480 亿美元（现汇率约合 2.98 万亿元人民币）预计在 2030 年底前支付，约 700 亿美元（现汇率约合 4,662.6 亿元人民币）需要在截至 2027 年 9 月的一年内兑付。Anthropic 已于 10 月 26 日递交 IPO 申请，计划在美国感恩节之前完成上市。知情人士透露，Anthropic 目标募资规模力争达到甚至超过 SpaceX 此前 862 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,741.66 亿元人民币）的 IPO 募资额。彭博社报道，参与这笔交易的投行收到投资者反馈：大家认可的合理估值区间已经下调至 1.4 万亿–1.5 万亿美元（现汇率约合 9.33 万亿– 9.99 万亿元人民币），但也有机会摸到 1.75 万亿美元（现汇率约合 11.66 万亿元人民币）附近。AI 模型研发和配套基础设施耗资巨大，各大企业因此动辄启动数百亿美元级别的融资。近几日科技股承压，市场对盈利预期的担忧，资金从 AI 板块流出。就在 Anthropic 公开招股的同一天（10 月 26 日），Meta 启动最高 980 亿美元（现汇率约合 6,527.64 亿元人民币）的股权融资计划，有望成为史上规模最大的股权融资之一；而在此之前，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 今年已经推出 850 亿美元（现汇率约合 5,661.73 亿元人民币）股权融资方案。甲骨文周一公布了 200 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,332.17 亿元人民币）融资计划，其中包含一笔 100 亿美元（现汇率约合 666.09 亿元人民币）股票增发；今年早些时候其已经通过债权、股权，包括 20 亿美元（现汇率约合 133.22 亿元人民币）场内增发完成一轮募资。Anthropic 本次 IPO 由公司自身与部分老股东出售股份，该公司也将是美国首家主打前沿大模型研发的上市公司。其竞争对手 OpenAI 则把上市计划推迟至明年，目前正在新一轮私募融资中谋求数百亿美元资金。两家公司冲刺巨额融资的同时，公众对 AI 安全的审视持续加码：接连发生多起智能体恶意入侵事件，市场激烈争论 AI 是否如 Anthropic 在招股书中写的那样，会带来“威胁人类生存的风险”。招股文件显示，本次 IPO 由高盛、摩根士丹利联席牵头承销，另有 20 家投行参与。股票将在纳斯达克全球精选市场挂牌，代码 ANT。

item.content: IT之家 11 月 2 日消息，据《The Information》今日报道，苹果正在开发 HomeView 的机器人版本。这款设备传闻被称作“HomeView Ultra”或“HomeView Max”，不过最终命名尚不确定。记者艾伦・蒂利（Aaron Tilley）表示，该设备原型机将一块 9 英寸屏幕搭载在可旋转机械臂上，整体外观类似苹果早年的 iMac G4，或是皮克斯的经典台灯吉祥物。它保留 FaceTime 通话这类 HomeView 已有的常规功能，同时还能够充分感知周边环境，并自主执行操作。▲ 苹果首款智能家庭中枢 HomeView报道写道：“这款机器人当前的设计方案，计划依靠摄像头与各类传感器感知周遭环境、自主行动。比如有人走进房间，设备可以自动开灯；甚至还能尝试把猫咪从桌上‘劝离’。同时它具备智能避障能力，避免意外磕碰周边物体。”报道提到，该设备硬件方案大体在两年前就已定型，但苹果内部出现意见分歧，争论焦点集中在：哪些软件功能应当在第一代产品落地，哪些功能需要推迟到正在规划的第二代机型上实现。报道称，苹果希望这款大号 HomeView 能够于 2027 年在美国上市，定价约 1,000 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 6,661 元人民币），但也有可能推迟至 2028 年才正式推出。苹果还探索过其他形态的家用机器人方案：带轮、可在家中跟随用户移动的机型；可在室内飞行的机型；还有能够叠衣服的机型。不过尚不清楚以上这些产品是否会最终对外发售。

item.content: Creality has finally caught up with the tool changer fad, presenting us with a speedy, four-nozzle system named “KliTek” mounted on a Creality K3. Tool changers are the way to go, since they do not compromise speed for color and eliminate the need to waste your filament in the form of “printer poop.” The K3 is still programmed to create a purge tower on multicolor prints, but this is a small fraction of the filament wasted using any type of AMS-style color system.The new KliTek nozzle system supports printing with different-sized nozzles in the same print, which sounds more useful than I actually found practical. Users will also be able to blend colors in Creality Print, a trick picked up from Snapmaker’s open-source Full Spectrum. This method creates the optical illusion of new colors by stacking very thin layers of filament.The tool-changing system works very well and never dropped or misplaced a tool during the review. Creality has tucked 37 sensors inside the printer, with 12 dedicated to the nozzle swapping process alone. No, I’m not going to name all of them, but they do work. I didn’t get a single bad print during the review, even when running at higher speeds. item.title: James Webb Space Telescope uncovers new clues about the origins of 'interstellar invader' comet 3I/ATLAS
item.content: Using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), scientists have found that the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS was built from tiny grains of ice mixed with dust that are quite different from the solar system’s comets. These ice grains do, however, bear striking similarities to some icy bodies located at the edge of the solar system, beyond the orbit of Neptune, so-called trans-Neptunian objects (TNOs).3I/ATLAS was discovered entering the solar system in the summer of 2025. It was only the third object found entering the solar system from farther afield in the Milky Way after 1I/'Oumuamua, seen in 2017, and 2I/Borisov, detected in 2019. This meant the interstellar comet offered a rare chance to glimpse the conditions under which such bodies form in other star systems. Thus, the JWST was quickly on the trail of 3I/ATLAS."We designed [JWST] to be ready the moment an active interstellar comet was found and to follow it over time," Martin Cordiner of NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center and the Catholic University of America said in a statement. item.title: F1 in Mexico City: Yet another Ferrari fiasco, but that’s not all
item.summary: There was plenty of drama on and off the track for Formula 1 this weekend.
item.content: Formula 1 has a new World Drivers' Champion. Just a few months after turning 20, Kimi Antonelli sealed his first title this weekend at Mexico City, becoming the sport’s youngest-ever champion. Elsewhere, there was drama aplenty, perhaps a consequence of the thin air affecting decision-making in some cases. The race was Ferrari’s to win, but yet again, the team handed victory to a rival this season, in this case Red Bull. Further down the grid, we saw a last-minute driver change in the Haas team, synchronized retirements from both Aston Martins, and the wheels literally coming off Cadillac Racing. And there was I, expecting a dull weekend. It might not be as high as Pikes Peak, but at an elevation of 7,350 feet (2,240 m) above sea level, the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez provides a unique challenge on the F1 calendar. Wings that would create huge amounts of downforce at circuits like Monaco just generate Monza-like levels in Mexico, and there’s little slipstream effect when following another car. Cooling tends to be a problem, too, with insufficient airflow across radiators, and obviously engine power is reduced with less oxygen to burn. item.title: Googling "Zelda" today offers a glimpse of how search worked in 1998
item.summary: "The flow of time is always cruel."
item.content: The year was 1998. Britney Spears topped the charts, Bill Clinton was impeached, and a couple of little websites called Google and Ars Technica came online. It was also the year Nintendo released The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the Nintendo 64. Google, which has come to dominate the Internet (Ars is still working on that), is celebrating the imminent release of the Ocarina of Time remaster by temporarily transporting us back to that storied year with a search Easter egg. To access the Google time machine, you just have to search for either "Zelda" or "Ocarina of Time." Google will load the standard 2026 results page, but you'll see an animated Master Sword in the lower right corner. It appears on both mobile and desktop—just click the sword and enjoy the show. After a little time-skipping animation and a Link shout (you know the one), you'll swear it's 1998 again. The search page is transformed into a simple list of blue links with retro Google branding. item.title: Most of our measures of a key cognitive process don't agree
item.summary: A big study with very little beyond negative results still gets published.
item.content: It's widely acknowledged that it's nearly impossible to publish negative results in scientific journals. "We didn't see anything" is a much harder sell than finding that a hypothesis is clearly right. Findings of no effect tend to either be shuffled off to low-profile journals or left behind as unpublished lab lore. The high-profile journal Nature, however, made a notable exception this week, publishing a study that tells us that a bunch of methods we have been using to try to measure a key emotional ability don't seem to be measuring the same thing. The results mean that we don't have a good way to measure the impact of a concept that is the basis of a key method in therapy. Inconsistencies One of the most successful forms of therapy is cognitive behavioral therapy, or CBT. In part, CBT is based on getting people to step back and engage in "cognitive reappraisal." This requires people to think over a situation that has caused a negative emotional response and find ways to reinterpret it so that it has less impact on them. The ability to engage in this process has been linked to emotional resilience.Read full article Comments
